dct_description_sm: This project represents the first and only controlled, standardized field experiment for the impact of overland seismic exploration vehicles under varying conditions of snow depth, snow density, surface crust, ground temperature, soil type, and vegetation type. The program was instituted in 2003 and the latest measurements were completed again in 2012. Ultimately, the project intends to provide natural resource managers with objective, quantitative data to assist decision making regarding cross country tundra travel typically associated with hydrocarbon exploration and development on the North Slope of the Alaskan arctic.
dct_title_s: Tundra Travel Model in the Arctic Foothills and Coastal Plain, Alaska
